status.en: 257 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 28% more than the week before, most of them in Abuja, Lagos and Plateau State.
status.nb: 257 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 28 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Abuja, Lagos og Plateau State.

summary.en: Gunmen in Plateau killed NSCDC officer Distu Garba Audu and abducted a businessman, while separate gunmen attacks on herders in the same state left two dead and six injured. In Kaduna, bandits abducted five people including a one-month-old baby and demanded N10 million for the release of a teacher, and a fisherman reported his fingers were cut off. Troops arrested seven suspects over the herders attack and police freed a Catholic priest and seven other abductees in Benue. The conflict produced 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Våpenbærende menn i Plateau drepte NSCDC-offiser Distu Garba Audu og bortførte en forretningsmann, mens separate væpnede angrep på hyrder i samme delstat førte til to døde og seks sårede. I Kaduna bortførte banditter fem personer, inkludert en én-måned gammel baby, og krevde 10 million Naira for løslatelsen av en lærer, og en fisker rapporterte at fingrene hans ble kuttet av. Tropper arresterte syv mistenkte i forbindelse med angrepet på hyrdene, og politiet frigjorde en katolsk prest og syv andre bortførte i Benue. Konflikten førte til 1 486 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Boko Haram insurgency
background.extract: The Boko Haram insurgency began in July 2009, when the militant Islamist and jihadist rebel group Boko Haram started an armed rebellion against the government of Nigeria. Boko Haram targets both Muslims and Christians. Attacks are often directed at individuals perceived as supporting the Nigerian government or Islamic State after the split between them, including civil servants, local defense groups, Muslim leaders who oppose the group and other rebels like al-Qaeda and Islamic State. Most attacks are not based on the religion of the victims.
